<div class="projects-header">

<h1>Software</h1>

<p>Open-source libraries and tooling for time series forecasting, distribution network analytics, load monitoring and the foundations of new code and document projects.</p>

<p class="software-stack"><span class="label">How they fit</span> <a href="https://pypi.org/project/pundamilia/">Milia</a> groups load profiles and detects abnormal days, <a href="https://pypi.org/project/twiga/">Twiga</a> forecasts them, and <a href="https://pypi.org/project/popo-flow/">Popo</a> simulates the low-voltage network that the forecasts and groups feed. The <a href="../books/mbuga.html">books</a> teach all three on energy and supply chain time series.</p>

</div>

## Other repositories

All public repositories are listed on [GitHub](https://github.com/sambaiga). The peer-reviewed work is on the [Research](../publication/index.html) page and the books are on the [Books](../books/index.html) page.
